summary: Implemented an editable instruction-files feature for gizmo: added protocol schemas for instruction targets and a new 'resources.instructions.read'/'write' request pair, a server-side instruction-files module that reads/writes the Pi system prompt override plus global and project AGENTS.md with safe allow-listed IO, corresponding service methods and request-handler cases, and existing-resource/allow-list integration via resourceRoots.
decisions: Instruction targets are modeled as a discriminated union in the protocol: 'system-prompt' (single global file), 'global-agents' (~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md), and 'project-agents' (<workspace>/AGENTS.md and <workspace>/.gizmo/AGENTS.md).

Per-target resolution of the file path is centralized in a new apps/agent-server/src/resources/instruction-files.ts module, mirroring the skill read/write pattern but dropping skill-specific markdown validation.
The project-agents allow-list is built from resourceRoots(workspacePath).agentsFiles rather than existingFiles(), so creating a missing AGENTS.md is supported.
Project-scoped writes require the workspace to be registered in the project catalog before the file path is resolved (added a #requireWorkspace guard on the service).
Symlinks are rejected on write (lstat + realpath equality check) to prevent escapes from the allowed path set.

System-prompt storage is kept as a plain file under the gizmo data dir (defaultDataDir()), separate from GlobalResourceStore's resources.json, and continues to be supplied to Pi via systemPromptOverride in pi-session-factory.ts rather than extending projectConfigSchema.
